title: netCDF node metadata
description: A group or variable of a netCDF file in the netCDF data model, as JSON: what `ncdump -h` shows. Attribute values are JSON numbers, strings or arrays; a single-element numeric attribute is written as a number and non-finite floats as "NaN", "Infinity" and "-Infinity". The HDF5 attributes that netCDF-4 uses internally to store dimensions (`DIMENSION_LIST`, `REFERENCE_LIST`, `CLASS`, `NAME`, `_Netcdf4Dimid`, `_Netcdf4Coordinates`, `_nc3_strict`) are not part of the data model and are omitted. Unofficial JSON Schema authored by hamk-uas/stac-schema-explorer to document and check metadata embedded in data files; it is not published or endorsed by the maintainers of the format or convention.

node_type.title: Node type
node_type.description: Whether the node is a group or a variable.

oneOf.title: Group
oneOf.description: The root group (the file) or a netCDF-4 subgroup: dimensions, attributes and variables.

oneOf.title: Variable
oneOf.description: An n-dimensional array with its own attributes.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the group or variable; the root group is named `/`.

format.title: File format
format.description: Format of the file, stated on the root group.

oneOf.title: 64-bit offset
oneOf.description: Classic model with 64-bit offsets for large files (CDF-2).

oneOf.title: 64-bit data
oneOf.description: Classic model with 64-bit data and dimension sizes (CDF-5).

oneOf.title: netCDF-4
oneOf.description: The enhanced data model stored in HDF5: groups, unsigned and 64-bit types, strings, chunking and compression.

oneOf.title: netCDF-4 classic model
oneOf.description: HDF5 storage restricted to the classic data model.

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: In a group, the dimensions it defines, by name, with their length. In a variable, the names of its dimensions from first (slowest varying) to last.

unlimited.title: Unlimited
unlimited.description: True for a dimension that can grow, such as a record (time) dimension.

items.title: Dimension name
items.description: Name of one dimension of the variable, from first (slowest varying) to last.

data_type.title: Data type
data_type.description: netCDF type of the variable's values.

oneOf.title: char
oneOf.description: 8-bit character, used for text in the classic model.

oneOf.title: User-defined
oneOf.description: A compound, enumeration, variable-length or opaque type (netCDF-4).

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: Length of each dimension of the variable.

chunk_shape.title: Chunk shape
chunk_shape.description: Shape of the HDF5 chunks of a chunked netCDF-4 variable; absent for contiguous storage.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: HDF5 filters applied to each chunk, in order, such as shuffle and deflate.

name.title: Filter name
name.description: Name of the filter as reported by the HDF5 library.

parameters.title: Parameters
parameters.description: Client data values of the filter, such as the deflate level.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Attributes of the group (global attributes on the root group) or of the variable. Conventions such as CF and ACDD, declared in the global `Conventions` attribute, define most of them.

_FillValue.title: Fill value
_FillValue.description: Value of elements that have not been written; also read as missing data. Defined by the netCDF library and the netCDF User Guide (https://docs.unidata.ucar.edu/netcdf-c/current/attribute_conventions.html).

_NCProperties.title: netCDF library provenance
_NCProperties.description: Versions of the netCDF and HDF5 libraries that created the file, written by the netCDF-C library on the root group of netCDF-4 files.

_Unsigned.title: Unsigned
_Unsigned.description: "true" when the integer values of a classic-model variable are to be read as unsigned (netCDF User Guide attribute convention).

units.title: Units
units.description: Units of the variable's values (netCDF User Guide attribute convention; CF requires UDUNITS syntax).

long_name.title: Long name
long_name.description: Descriptive name of the variable (netCDF User Guide attribute convention).

valid_min.title: Valid minimum
valid_min.description: Smallest valid value (netCDF User Guide attribute convention).

valid_max.title: Valid maximum
valid_max.description: Largest valid value (netCDF User Guide attribute convention).

valid_range.title: Valid range
valid_range.description: Smallest and largest valid values (netCDF User Guide attribute convention).

scale_factor.title: Scale factor
scale_factor.description: Multiplier applied to the stored values when they are read (netCDF User Guide attribute convention).

add_offset.title: Offset
add_offset.description: Added to the stored values after scaling when they are read (netCDF User Guide attribute convention).

missing_value.title: Missing value
missing_value.description: Value or values that mark missing data (netCDF User Guide attribute convention).

title.title: Title
title.description: Short description of what is in the file (netCDF User Guide attribute convention).

history.title: History
history.description: Log of the programs that have modified the file, one line per program run (netCDF User Guide attribute convention).

Conventions.title: Conventions
Conventions.description: Names of the conventions the file follows, separated by commas or spaces, for example `CF-1.11, ACDD-1.3` (netCDF User Guide attribute convention).
